scope: Stage-A frozen spacer 445-455 nm exact 1 nm polarization-angle matrix
source_implementation: single BFAST plane-wave source at z=-250 nm inside lossy native GaN; internal theta is calibrated at 450 nm from authoritative GaN readback and BFAST preserves the broadband injection angle
boundary_implementation: BFAST built-in transverse boundary for x; periodic y for ky/k0=0; longitudinal z PML; explicit FDTD x/y properties are read back and recorded but BFAST owns the oblique transverse phase

polarization.P_XLIKE: polarization angle 0 deg; E in x-z plane with k dot E = 0 and continuous normal-incidence +x limit
polarization.S_YLIKE: polarization angle 90 deg; E parallel physical y with k dot E = 0

transversality_rule: evaluate native GaN n(lambda) with getfdtdindex at each exact wavelength; P uses E proportional to (kz,0,-kx), S uses (0,1,0); record normalized k dot E residual
readback_requirements: BFAST source type and source angle
per-wavelength transmitted m=0 air-side ux readback
solver_entry_policy: one broadband solver entry per incident state; replay requires explicit new authorization
